verdict.rationale: cubic generates AI insights and suggestions from the user's code and PR data inside the product. It posts review comments on bugs and improvements, offers a context-aware chat sidebar that can tour a PR or answer questions about selected code, produces an AI wiki of the codebase, and runs AI codebase scans for bugs and vulnerabilities. A community tester reports the comments became quieter and more useful. Missing for 10: AI-generated insights over the analytics dashboard data (it shows metrics but no AI summaries), and stronger independent corroboration of suggestion quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Comments on bugs and improvements in pull requests
The chat sidebar helps you quickly understand and navigate your pull requests (PRs) with intelligent, context-aware assistance directly within cubic.
Select code and choose **Add to AI chat** to ask about it with the diff and codebase as context.
cubic's AI wiki automatically indexes your codebase and produces searchable wikis, complete with links to source code, architecture diagrams, and more.
Codebase scans deploy thousands of AI agents to find bugs and vulnerabilities across your repository.
